instruction: The "~/pictures/" directory in my file system has photo files organized in sub-directories for each vacation spot. Compress them and save them in "~/pictures/vacations/<vacation_spot>.zip" for each vacation spot, and then delete all vacation spot sub-directories. Here, <vacation_spot> is the name of the vacation spot as it appears in the sub-directory name.

import os
base_dir = '/home/adrian/pictures/vacations'
access_token = globals()['access_token']
spots = ['santorini','seoul']
results = {}
for spot in spots:
    spot_dir = f"{base_dir}/{spot}/"
    zip_req = f"~/pictures/vacations/{spot}.zip"
    print('---', spot, '---')
    resp = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
        access_token=access_token,
        directory_path=spot_dir,
        compressed_file_path=zip_req,
        overwrite=False,
        delete_directory=False
    )
    print('compress_resp', resp)
    zip_abs = resp.get('compressed_file_path')
    exists_resp = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=access_token, file_path=zip_abs)
    print('zip_abs', zip_abs)
    print('exists_resp', exists_resp)
    if not exists_resp.get('exists', False):
        raise RuntimeError(f'Zip not created for {spot}')
    del_resp = apis.file_system.delete_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=spot_dir)
    print('delete_resp', del_resp)
    results[spot] = {'zip': zip_abs, 'deleted': True}
print('done', results)
